split_rationale: Partitioned at the paper level to prevent sentence leakage between sets. The development partition contains papers directly referenced in rule comments, unit test fixtures, or earlier experiment claim-mapping annotations. The held-out partition contains papers whose sentences were not used in unit test fixtures.
methodology_disclaimer: CAUTION FOR PUBLICATION: The held-out partition represents an internal diagnostic partition, NOT an independent out-of-domain test benchmark. Both Devlin et al. (NLP) and Martineau et al. (Vitamin D) share domain context with the development papers. Fully independent testing requires collecting papers from unseen scientific disciplines (e.g. physics, biochemistry, social science).
